outputs.description: Formation energies of Na2-2xSrxLi2Ti6O14 compositions. The checker verifies structural trends and internal consistency.
Average Bader charge on Ti atoms for each composition. The checker audits structural properties.

output_contract.notes: The agent may use any open-source DFT code as an alternative to the commercial VASP. The formation energy step must report total energies from which formation energies can be recomputed. The Bader charge scoring relies on structural properties without stating the expected trend.
